method: Decoded both MP4s (1660 frames each, 30fps, 1080x1920) to raw RGB with ffmpeg -fps_mode passthrough, indexed frames by decode order into /tmp/rv_review2. Built source|render side-by-side crops (y650-1290; y860-1060 strips; y1280-1440 captions) and inspected them visually. Measured per-frame change events (270x480 gray diffs), ink bboxes, teal bubble extents (f154-245), red-arrow left-edge x per frame (SH005 f366-440, SH017 f1047-1104), caption ink onset (f1040-1104) and colour histograms. Project numbers were not used.

defects: Bubble appears at f154 in render vs f159 in source (5 frames early); the hold-frame cadence is also out of phase (source holds at 160/165/170..., render at 157/162/167...), so the extent is off by about 4px on alternate frames
At f229 the render bubble is about 12px shorter vertically (y718-1191 vs y712-1197)

dollar_bare: the two vertical bars meet at the top (x~515-540, y~845); in the source the left bar is separate and shorter. The S has no inner gap at lower left. White anti-alias specks on the outline at about (488,918) and (598,978)
Bubble highlights: the upper-left highlight is straighter and more vertical with visible seam ticks at about (458,768),(490,820),(352,950); the lower-right highlight is thinner
Burst f230: particle positions match, but the streaks are straight capsules (source streaks are curved, and the lower-right one hooks at about (705,1110)). The large droplet's highlight differs
Burst at f230 and clear at f243 are frame-exact
Slide-left hold cadence wrong: source holds at 306-307/311-312/316-317, render at 304-305/309-310/314-315, giving horizontal errors up to 20-25px at f305, f310 and f315
Man is about 6px low at the head top (y871 vs 865) and the body ends 6px short (y1257 vs 1263)
man_brown hair: smoother band, missing the source's top spike (about x345,y865 at f310) and the fringe dipping over the forehead; white speck on the hair outline at about (120,948 at f319)
Earth continents still differ: the upper-right ice cap is smaller, the right green continent is a broader block, and the left rim has a notch at about (488,950)
Earth ocean is about 50% more mid-blue area; the darkest navy (#10102f) shading and the thick black continent outlines are thinner or missing (dark-ink pixels 74k vs 80k)
Earth entry at f319 and sweat drop at f339 are frame-exact; the drop is slightly smaller (about 40x55 vs 45x65)
Year/June font still wrong: render uses a heavy bold rounded face (stroke ~14px), source a thin handwritten monoline (~7px) with an open 4 and a crossed 8. Obvious at playback scale

Scroll motion profile wrong: source moves in uniform 80px steps with holds (arrow x 71,151,151,230,310...), render uses uneven steps (181,181,261,301...). Errors up to 110px at f366 and 40-90px at f370 (2010 at x100 vs 60, arrow at x400 vs 310)
Step changes 1 frame late at 367->368, 372->373, 377->378, 382->383, 387->388 and so on; the landing step at f399 is short (600 vs 640)
Digits sit about 5px lower and are taller
Final hold from f405 matches the source position (arrow x190, calendar x135-260)
hips hair is still a solid dark slab with a flat top (x~555-670, y~765-800); source is a loose scribble of separate spiky strokes
Body, face, arms and the arm change at f525 match within 2px
Same hair slab defect
Change events at f634 and f636 match
Same hair slab defect
The source changes at f720/721 are compression noise, not content
Same hair slab defect
The source changes at f840/841 are compression noise
Same wrong bold year/June font as SH005

Scroll is linear 24px/frame; the source eases with a wobble (arrow x 177,147,118,118,111,82,53,22,22,17,21 vs render 166,142,118,118,94,70,46,22,22,0,8). Errors up to 17-23px at f1069, f1074 and f1079

Caption 'then' appears at f1048 in render vs f1049 in source (1 frame early); later words are frame-exact (1061,1065,1072,1078,1082,1089). The caption font is about 16% heavier (dark pixels 11.3k vs 9.6k)
Cut in at 1047 and out at 1105 are exact
Flame swaps at 1107/1115/1120/1125/1135/1145/1155 are frame-exact. Flame silhouettes now match closely (tongues within ~5px)
earth_A/B: the eye ovals are narrower (about 80px vs 100px wide, e.g. left eye x440-520 vs 430-530) and the spirals smaller
Ocean lacks the darkest navy shading and has thinner black outlines (dark ink 95k vs 127k px); MAD 16 across the shot

overall: PARTIAL - not GO. Cuts, flame swaps, burst and most event timing are correct. SH005 fails on font and scroll motion; the hips hair and font fixes were not achieved; the SH003 bubble onset is 5 frames early; and the SH004 and SH017 motion cadences deviate by up to 20-25px.
